result.title: M-Plan: Comprehensive Planning For LLM Agents with Memory Arrangement
result.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have recently demonstrated outstanding performance in single-turn tasks, yet they continue to struggle with long-horizon tasks, particularly in environments without prior training. A key limitation of single LLMs is their difficulty in processing long contexts, which stems from weaknesses in continuous decision-making and reasoning capabilities. Although existing multi-agent systems (MAS) equipped with long-term memory bases can partially address this gap, they mostly rely on knowledge reuse or summarization, an approach that is often constrained by directly retrieval without any adaptation for the current task, while the retrieved memory may contain much history noises waiting to be preprocessed. In contrast, MAS characterized by task-specific guidance often lack long-term memory specifically designed for the guidance. To address these challenges, we propose M-Plan, a closed-loop MAS framework that integrates long-term and short-term memory. By combining global-local and past-current guidance, M-Plan enhances agents' performance on multi-turn tasks while maintaining a plug-and-play design. During task execution, agents receive task-specific milestones and insights, and are provided with local hints only when confusion arises, which form global-local guidance together. These guidance generation and utilization construct the short-term memory as well. After task completion, relevant information about the current task is optimized or reorganized before being sent to the long-term memory storage for future retrieval. The designments mentioned above build a comprehensive framework different from other individual long-term or short-term memory works. Extensive experiments on multi-turn tasks including ALFWorld, Webshop, and PDDL across diverse models demonstrate that M-Plan outperforms multiple baseline methods in both accuracy and efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 M-Plan 闭环多智能体框架，将长期记忆与短期记忆结合：执行中给出全局里程碑与「困惑时才触发」的局部提示，任务结束后对信息重组织再存入长期记忆，以提升长程多轮任务的表现与效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本智能体记忆工作，但其「困惑触发局部提示」与检索前噪声预处理可能启发 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选，可供核查状态维护机制是否可迁移。
